rule: Select one primary packet. Actual proof dependencies and status require original evidence; upstream lists are advisory. Review nominees recuse if contributors.

assignments.target_statement: Reproduce H=2a and I=1+a/2 for a-bit addressing, and compare coordinatewise, one-root, and posterior code costs. Derive the asymptotic ratio of each proposed cost to I.

deliverables.description: ADDRESSING_BASELINE.tex: exact spectrum, H, I, and three code costs
ADDRESSING_CONTROL.json: fixed small controls and symbolic asymptotics

acceptance_criteria: Prove H=2a and I=1+a/2 for a fresh a-bit selector and distinct data characters, including a=0.
Compute coordinatewise, complete-set one-root, and posterior costs under their actual code definitions; do not assume the bad code's asymptotic loss.
Treat the O(a) repair and sharp H=4(I−1) relation as existing baselines rather than new research results.
assignments.renewal_milestone: One accepted calibration is reused everywhere; retire the packet after discrepancies between implementations are resolved.

assignments.target_statement: Build iterated address functions with controlled input reuse. Derive exact recursive entropy and influence ledgers and identify where the same gate label can be shared across levels.

deliverables.description: RECURSIVE_ADDRESSING.tex: explicit family and level-by-level exact H/I recurrence
REUSE_CONDITIONS.json: selector freshness and branch-dependence certificate

acceptance_criteria: Specify at each node which coordinates are fresh selectors and which are shared data; shared control variables require a new proof.
Account for cross-level coefficient collisions and selector influence, instead of multiplying disjoint-composition formulas through reuse.
Show an unbounded-depth or unbounded-arity regime beyond an already proved orthogonal-selector iteration, or identify why the candidate lies within that baseline.
assignments.renewal_milestone: A new recursive family with a closed exact ledger or a rigorous obstruction to its claimed closure is ready for review.

assignments.target_statement: Exploit the exact Walsh collision identity for arbitrary overlapping branches. Characterize when posterior label entropy cancels the selector alphabet cost and when coherent interference adds entropy.

deliverables.description: COLLISION_BLOCK_INTERFACE.tex: R_T, r_T, ν_T, B_W, M_W and exact decrement
COLLISION_CONTROLS.json: identical, opposite, orthogonal, and bent-splice branches

acceptance_criteria: Prove or source-pin Δ_WH=Σ_T R_T H(ν_T)+a−Σ_T R_T H(r_T) with zero-mass T omitted and all quantities normalized.
Identify B_W=Σ_T R_T H(ν_T), M_W=a−Σ_T R_T H(r_T), and 0≤M_W≤(2/ln2)I_W as the exact B04→B06 interface.
Reproduce complete selector-cost cancellation for identical branches and the existing bent-splice failure of a universal Δ_selH≤C I_sel bound; no new constant-correlation theorem is claimed here.

next_consumers.interface_use: exact collision and block decrement interface

assignments.renewal_milestone: One reviewed shared-data/block interface is frozen and handed to A019/A027/A057/A058; new conjectures move to those packets.

assignments.target_statement: Start from the already proved disagreement closure C′=max{2/c,C}. Prove a uniform positive neighboring-disagreement bound from a genuinely new unbounded class, or sharply control the exact collision debt as disagreement tends to zero under explicit structure. Import the bent-splice falsifier and do not rederive the existing constant-correlation corollary as a new result.

deliverables.description: NEW_SHARED_DATA_CLASS.tex: explicit growing family and structural theorem
COLLISION_PAYMENT.md: derived disagreement or exact vanishing-disagreement cancellation

acceptance_criteria: Treat C′=max{2/c,C} under a proved uniform neighboring disagreement c>0 as an existing corollary, not the proposed new result.
Either prove a uniform c from a genuinely new unbounded-depth/arity class outside current structural hypotheses, or bound the exact collision debt under a stated structure when c→0.
Apply the a=1 bent-splice control with I_sel=2^(−m) and Δ_selH/I_sel≥m−1; any valid new hypothesis must explain why its claimed payment survives or excludes that family.

advisory_upstream.interface: exact collision and block decrement interface
bent-splice and nearly identical branch guards

next_consumers.interface_use: boundary of the already studied selector classes

assignments.renewal_milestone: A newly admitted unbounded class or a nontrivial exact collision payment as c→0, with no universal selector-only increment assumption.

assignments.target_statement: Construct selectors with coincident Fourier supports, unequal cell sizes, affine cells, and nearly identical branches. Refute any proposed closure that silently discards interference or selector influence.

deliverables.description: SELECTOR_FALSIFIER_SUITE.tex: exact unequal-cell, support-collision, affine, and near-equality controls
SELECTOR_FAILURE_SCOPE.json: precise hypothesis or constant invalidated

acceptance_criteria: Include the recovered bent-splice family analytically, with one selector bit and divergent decrement-to-selector-influence ratio.
Compute the actual shared coefficients before squaring; coincident Fourier supports are not treated as a disjoint mixture.
An unequal-cell or near-identical-branch counterexample states whether it breaks separation, uniform disagreement, or a proposed new collision payment.

next_consumers.interface_use: bent-splice and nearly identical branch guards

assignments.renewal_milestone: At least one candidate-specific exclusion or certified new failure is handed to A019/A027/A058.
